title: Irish Cream Frittata with Indian Spices
description: A twist on a classic frittata, with the addition of creamy irish spices. A delicious breakfast dish for any occasion.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, cottage cheese, and crushed frittata.
Add the diced potatoes to the bowl and stir until coated.
Pour the potato mixture into the skillet with the onion mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve warm.
Serve with naan or rice for a filling breakfast.
